title: FrediFrets-Challenges
description: Add exciting Minecraft challenges like random drops, chunk effects, expanding borders, and hardcore modes – all controllable with simple commands.
body:
## ✨ Description

FrediFrets Challenges Plugin is a feature-rich challenge plugin designed to make Minecraft gameplay more exciting and unpredictable.
It’s perfect for streamers, YouTubers, community servers, or anyone who wants to spice up vanilla Minecraft with fun, unique twists.

### 🧩 Features
	•	Randomizer Modes
Randomize mob drops, block drops, and chest loot. Every item you break or loot could be something completely unexpected, making every run different.
	•	Chunk Effects
Every chunk applies a unique potion effect (levels 1–3) to players inside it. Crossing into a new chunk can give you Strength, Speed, or even harmful effects like Poison – no two chunks are alike.
	•	XP / Damage Border
The world border expands whenever players gain XP or take damage. This creates a dynamic, progressing play area that changes as you play.
	•	Extreme Survival Modes
	•	One Heart: Survive with only a single heart.
	•	One Slot: You can only carry one inventory slot.
	•	One Hunger Bar: Play with a single hunger bar for a truly hardcore experience.
Combine them for the ultimate challenge!
	•	Simple Commands
Start or stop challenges easily:

/challenge start <name>
/challenge stop <name>


	•	Highly Replayable
Each challenge can be toggled individually, letting you customize your server events, speedruns, or mini-games. Mix and match challenges for endless possibilities.

You can change the Timer Design with:
/challenge timerdesign (here the design)
You can turn the Timer on/off with:
/challenge timer on/off
### 🎯 Why Use This Plugin?

This plugin offers ready-to-use challenges that keep your players entertained without complicated setups.
It’s lightweight, easy to install, and gives your server an edge with unique gameplay modes.

### 🚀 Perfect For
	•	Content creators wanting unique video ideas
	•	Server owners hosting events or competitions
	•	Friends who want to spice up their survival worlds

Bring chaos, fun, and unpredictability to Minecraft with FrediFrets Challenges Plugin!
